## Company Overview

Lumilens operates in AI, Data & Cloud Infrastructure and is based in Belmont, California. Its latest recorded funding round was a Series C round in August 2026.

Lumilens is a connectivity products company that develops photonics products intended to improve the computing performance of data centers and AI.

## Recent news

Latest coverage and updates

- hiresSep 24, 2026

Lumilens Inc. appoints Deepa Subbaiah as global head-HR in Karnataka on Sep 25th '26, where she focuses on building the talent, leadership and culture supporting the company’s growth.

- has\_valuationAug 11, 2026

In New York on Aug 11th '26, Lumilens Inc. tops a $5.51B valuation after its latest funding, bringing its total capital raised to more than $900 million.

- identified\_as\_competitor\_ofAug 10, 2026

The article identifies Lumilens Inc. as a competitor of Eoptolink Technology Inc. in the crowded optical interconnect market for AI data centres, alongside Nvidia, Broadcom and other startups.

- receives\_financingAug 9, 2026

Lumilens Inc. receives $700M in Series C financing at a $5.51B valuation in Aug '26, in a round co-led by Atreides Management, Bain Capital Ventures, Meritech, Seligman Ventures, and Spark Capital, and plans to use the capital to scale production and advance optical interconnect manufacturing for AI data centers.
